import os
path='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-low-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u088/system/state/workspace/programs/task-ebaa131a.py'

source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = {(r, c): grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]}
    seen, comps = set(), []
    for (r, c), color in cells.items():
        if (r, c) in seen: continue
        stack, comp = [(r, c)], []
        seen.add((r, c))
        while stack:
            rr, cc = stack.pop()
            comp.append((rr, cc, color))
            for p in ((rr-1,cc),(rr+1,cc),(rr,cc-1),(rr,cc+1)):
                if p in cells and cells[p] == color and p not in seen:
                    seen.add(p); stack.append(p)
        comps.append(comp)
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    comps.sort(key=lambda comp: max(c for r,c,v in comp), reverse=True)
    for comp in comps:
        shift = 0
        while True:
            nxt = shift + 1
            if any(c+nxt >= w or (out[r][c+nxt] and (r,c+nxt) not in {(rr,cc+shift) for rr,cc,v in comp}) for r,c,v in comp): break
            shift = nxt
        for r,c,v in comp: out[r][c+shift] = v
    return out
'''
open(path,'w').write(source)
